name: Conceptual Integrity
axiom: Every module should express the same set of design ideas in the same way.
trigger: Two screens in one product use different labels, layouts, or gestures for the same job, so each has to be learned from scratch.

checklist.text: Open the same kind of record the same way everywhere: one dialog, one drawer, or one page.
Give one permission level one verb across the product; grep the interface strings for synonyms.
Render page headers from one component so type, spacing, and breadcrumbs cannot drift apart.

antiPattern.violation: A dashboard creates a project in a modal, a task on a new page, and a client in a drawer.
antiPattern.remediation: All record creation opens the same slide-over sheet, with the same button order and unsaved-changes guard.

academicOrigin.title: The Mythical Man-Month: Essays on Software Engineering
